topic: Zoomable Memory Tree and stronger next-run action
currentUserGoal: Make the Memory Grove skill tree zoomable for a much larger future catalog and make Begin Next Run more enticing.
workCompleted: Moved Memory Tree nodes and connectors into a masked Phaser container with a dedicated viewport transform.
Added bounded 60%-180% zoom through minus, percentage-reset, plus, and mouse-wheel controls; pointer-anchored zoom preserves the inspected branch.
Added drag-pan while zoomed above 100%, with clamped movement and stable layout work outside the frame loop.
Mirrored tree navigation into the DOM agent layer and clipped both Phaser and DOM node hitboxes to the visible tree viewport.
Reworked the compact Memory Grove tree into smaller name-only nodes with separated tap targets and a readable selected-memory detail layout.
Enlarged Begin Next Run to a primary footer action and added a restrained idle glow/text pulse without animating its hitbox.
Added unit coverage for zoom clamping, pan clamping, and pointer-anchored zoom math.
Updated the durable redesign and implementation-plan documents with the Memory Tree navigation contract and future catalog direction.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 37 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Browser smoke verified zoom buttons at 100%, 120%, and 140%, the 60% minimum disabled state, pointer-anchored wheel zoom, bounded drag-pan, and reset to 100% with zero pan.
Browser debug state confirmed node bounds are clipped at the tree viewport while zoomed and DOM controls expose the current zoom percentage.
Responsive browser screenshots at 390x844 confirmed the compact title, controls, nodes, and detail copy no longer overlap.
A clean fast-dormancy run confirmed the enlarged Begin Next Run footer is unobstructed on the real game-over screen.
Browser console check reported no warnings or errors.
currentGitStatus: Expected after this handoff commit: clean worktree on codex/gameplay-update, two commits ahead of origin/codex/gameplay-update.
knownIssues: The Memory catalog still contains only five functional skills; the larger branch catalog and progression economy are a separate design slice.
Tree zoom/pan is session UI state and is intentionally not persisted into the permanent Memory save.
The current normalized five-node layout is ready for navigation but will need a data-driven world extent when the catalog grows beyond a single overview.
nextRecommendedSteps: Design the first larger Memory catalog: branch identities, prerequisites, costs, and run-changing effects before adding nodes.
Promote tree coordinates and world extent into data so new branches expand the navigable canvas without scene-layout edits.
Add fit-to-tree or branch-focus navigation once the first larger catalog proves the required world size.
Continue hands-on pacing work for the 2x2-to-3x3 run chapters.
doNotRevert: Keep tree content inside the geometry-masked container and keep all node hitboxes clipped to that viewport.
Keep zoom and pan transform-only; do not trigger full scene layout on pointer movement.
Keep the Begin Next Run hitbox stable while its presentation pulses.
Every new run must still return to one tile at mastery rank 0 while permanent GT and Memory upgrades survive.
